messages:
tara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we still have noisy alerts for pgcpu and frontend-restarts. Need to assign owners for: dedupe, threshold tuning, and paging policy handback. Two recurring patterns: short batch spikes (~1-2m) and long restart tails (~10-20m).

alex_m: I can take the batch spikes. Will run a 7d query and propose a threshold + short suppression window by EOD Thu.

rui: I can own dedupe rules. Thinking grouping_key = job + pod_name and a 2m dedupe window. Will validate on staging.

samir: I’ll handle the paging policy change (reduce on-call noise). Drafting a proposal: only page on sustained >5m for now, with an escape hatch for severity=critical. Will share doc.

oncall-bot: Created issue INC-412 for alert cleanup tasks and linked this thread.

alex_m: Quick note on data — batch spikes align with nightly batch-run at 03:10 UTC. Suggest adding label job=batch-run and exclude in alerting for below 5s p95 CPU.

rui: Example rule I’ll test in staging:
```
- alert: HighPGCPU
  expr: sum by (job, pod) (rate(pg_cpu_seconds_total[1m])) > 0.8
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://go/redwood/ops/pgcpu
```

rui: My plan: run grouping + dedupe for 48h in staging, then deploy to canary two nodes, monitor, then full rollout. ETA Mon.

tara: Great. Can each owner drop a calendar invite for a 30m sync next Tue to review results? Also add the runbook link and a small eval queries list to the doc.

samir: Added initial doc: https://go/redwood/ops/alerts/cleanse (will flesh with example queries). Invite sent for Tue 10:00am PT.

alex_m: Ack. I’ll paste my query outputs to the doc by Thu.

rui: Ack — will add canary metrics dashboard and a short checklist for rollback on the doc.

tara: Action items summary: 1) alex_m: batch threshold proposal (Thu EOD) 2) rui: dedupe rule + canary plan (Mon) 3) samir: paging policy draft + runbook updates (Tue sync) — owners please update INC-412 with PR links and timelines. :thumbsup:

alex_m: :+1:

rui: :white_check_mark:

samir: :raised_hands:
